content.text: THE MASTERS2026 Masters purse, prize money payouts for every player at Augusta Cameron JourdanGolfweekUpdated April 12, 2026, 7:59 p.m. ET0:01/0:30Keep WatchingAUGUSTA, Ga. — The 2026 Masters came to a close Sunday.Rory McIlroy and Cameron Young were tied for the lead with 18 holes to play at Augusta National Golf Club, but there were plenty of chasers and plenty or birdies available Sunday.There's a record $22.5 million purse, with $4.5 million going to the winner.
